title: Bobo's Rainbow

coreLoop: tap Start, then drag to move the bear
catch falling hearts (gold hearts worth more)
each catch visibly restores part of the rainbow
restore all six rainbow bands by reaching 12 hearts to win
missed hearts simply fall away — no penalty (gentle mode)
the fall speed ramps up gently as the session progresses
restart from the result card after a win
fairness: hearts must be reachable within the playfield
spawn and fall speed must allow a reasonable reaction window
the pacing ramp must not make success practically impossible

reviewFocus: Check that the bear, kitten, hearts, and rainbow read clearly at portrait mobile size.
Check whether collecting hearts visibly repairs the rainbow and communicates progress toward helping the kitten.
Evaluate whether missed hearts and the speed ramp create a fair learning curve.
Check touch targets, contrast, HUD overlap, and whether the restart affordance is actually usable.
